svg.title: Durgesh Reddiyar, robotics researcher: safe and secure robot autonomy with reinforcement learning
svg.desc: Profile header. Robotics researcher in Pune, India, working on safe and secure robot autonomy with reinforcement learning. M.S. Robotics at Arizona State University, over two years in industry with General Motors safety approval, two manuscripts and one journal article, currently a research software engineer. A technical line drawing of a quadrotor with callouts: rotor 3 with partial thrust loss, a GRU fault detector, a PPO mission policy, and the unmodified PX4 autopilot.

g.text: Today, a learned policy that recovers from rotor faults the
autopilot never notices. Next, robots that detect and survive
spoofed sensors and attacks on learned policies.
D. Y. Patil · clinical gait study
PX4 · Isaac Lab · ROS 2 · Gazebo · PyTorch · C++ · Python
